turns.prompt: We'll write a rhyming couplet about a garden after frost, in two steps. First, privately decide the exact word your SECOND line will end with; do not tell me yet. Then reply with only the FIRST line of the couplet.
turns.reply: The frost lay silver on the withered ground,

turns.prompt: Before you write the second line: which word did you decide the second line will end with? Reply with just that word.
Now reply with only the second line of the couplet.
turns.reply: Where once bright blooms in summer light were found,
